Name: CP - SH's Cuter Pepper Rex
Author: plurffle
Description:
I personally liked using [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3620]IdentityPollution's Cuter Fatter Dinos[/url]﻿ [size=1](very cute! highly recommended!)[/size] I noticed the Pepper Rexes that were added in the new update have a chance of having dino eggs with them. I decided to turn the Pepper Rex into a bigger version of the cuter dinos mod to make them match (so it's like this is the fully grown version of the cuter dinos mod﻿)! I just got my screen tab and this was a good exercise

So, credits to IdentityPollution for the original design!

[size=1]might tweak the sprites, i dunno[/size]



I just created a Ko-fi! If you like my works, then feel free to [url=https://ko-fi.com/smolhooman_plurffle]buy me a coffee[/url]﻿~! I'll greatly appreciate the support! <3 However, my mods will always stay free for the public!
